_comment: Success-score component weights, per position. Goal contributions (perf_level/perf_delta) are a weak-to-meaningless signal for defenders/goalkeepers (most keepers have 0 goals+assists both before and after a move), so their weight is shifted toward value growth, playing time, and value for money instead. Shared by scripts/build_dataset.py (computes the label) and app/main.py (labels the 'why this score' explanation). Each row must sum to 1.0.
